record_kind: Internally timestamped prospective v2 analysis plan on retrospective public data. No external preregistration claim. Known v1 AlphaGenome findings recorded separately; no new open-model predictions observed.
training_dataset: Kircher 2019, canonical SNVs with >=10 barcodes; published coefficients, not manufactured per-variant SEs

validation_conditions.Ulirsch: K562_CTRL, centered 1/2 insert; GATA1 perturbations excluded
validation_conditions.Abell: GM12878, 1KGTest/1KGControl Base SNVs; Sabeti reused controls/haplotypes excluded

independence: Exclude all validation 1 Mb blocks appearing in Kircher; exclude Abell blocks appearing in Ulirsch. Blocks are conservative genomic clusters, not guaranteed LD-independent units.
primary_point_prediction: Frozen cell-matched Enformer DNASE signed log2 fold score; no oracle best-of-modality selection. Borzoi scored as a second frozen model.
Enformer_port: Pinned released PyTorch conversion, corrected TensorFlow gamma at length1536; do not claim exact TensorFlow393216-context reproduction
orientations: Forward and reverse-complement mean; stranded Borzoi outputs remapped with explicit strand_pair metadata
retention_rule: Exactly floor(rate*n) within dataset/1Mb block using QC-primary eligible variants only. Selection uses model scores, never external effects or replicate values.
audit_views: Ulirsch: disjoint RNA halves with distinct DNA replicates, then swap. Abell: each paired replicate screens |effect|>=0.5; the other two provide sign truth. Screening threshold is an audit-label definition, never an inference-time feature or gate.
noise_ceiling: Classical additive measurement-error correction, r(pred,mean_effect)/sqrt(1-mean(SEM^2)/var(mean_effect)). Abell paired SEM^2=var(rep_effect)/3; Ulirsch SEM^2=var(RNA_logratio)/6+var(DNA_logratio)/2. Report nonpositive reliability and corrected correlations>1 as unidentified/unstable; never clip into credible-looking values.
primary_policy: Kircher-trained residual sign-error risk classifier using deployment-available Enformer/Borzoi score summaries. Fixed HGB depth/iterations, source-family fit/calibration split, source-only scales and probability calibration.
primary_comparator: Magnitude-only selection of |Enformer DNASE score|, same forecast and exact retention.
adjustment: Partial rank correlations of block/element reliability with inference-only scores controlling rank(measured assay spread) and rank(mean SEM). Audit covariates never enter deployment scores. Diagnostic aftereffects cannot tune primary policy.
magnitude_conditional_test: Match per-block, per-source-frozen-magnitude-quintile selection budgets to magnitude-only; require positive paired error reduction in both external datasets. This tests information beyond magnitude without using test labels to set budgets.
success_rule: PASS only if each independent dataset has >=20 retained audit-sign calls and >=10 contributing 1Mb blocks; same retention for all policies; source-only risk policy reduces aggregate screened-and-held-out-sign error versus magnitude-only with Bonferroni two-dataset97.5% paired block-bootstrap lower CI>0 in BOTH datasets; conditional-within-magnitude test has positive95% lower CI in BOTH; at least90% of magnitude policy audited sign opportunities retained; and full-retention primary point correlation has positive95% lower CI in BOTH. If adequately evaluable but any benefit/fidelity gate fails: FAIL. Missing resources, incomplete scoring, or insufficient calls/blocks: INCONCLUSIVE. Secondary policies cannot rescue FAIL.
effect_definition: Recomputed log2 ALT/REF RNA ratios minus log2 ALT/REF DNA ratios from public counts with a fixed0.5 pseudocount; not the source publication DESeq2 p-values, not clinical pathogenicity
AlphaGenome: Gate closed by default. Algebraic/raw comparisons may be acquired. ANY fitted map, risk estimator or partial-regression analysis involving AlphaGenome outputs requires ALPHAGENOME_CALIBRATION_PERMISSION=1 under applicable terms. Primary open-model verdict does not require AlphaGenome.
limits: Independent functional assays are not necessarily loci withheld from foundation-model training. Episomal reporter effects differ from endogenous regulation. Shared track/model training and assay noise limit causal and probabilistic claims.

amendment_before_open_predictions.reason: Source audit found repeated Abell Base constructs and ambiguous independence of Ulirsch RNA library replicates. No new open-model outputs have been observed.
amendment_before_open_predictions.canonical_construct: One lexicographically smallest source row ID per QC-eligible Abell genomic variant. No effect-based choice.
amendment_before_open_predictions.replicate_assumption: Ulirsch six RNA libraries and two DNA libraries are treated as separate samples for an approximate variance model; unmodeled technical or shared biological covariance may remain. Abell has three reported independent paired transfections.
amendment_before_open_predictions.corrected_correlation: Correlations outside [-1,1] are reported as unstable and excluded from adjusted-correlation audits, rather than clipped.
amendment_before_open_predictions.implementation_detail_note: Exact fixed features, hyperparameters and source-group hash split made explicit before any v2 model outputs. Prediction spread is computed only from candidate context model outputs.

fixed_features: log1p absolute Enformer DNASE score / source-fit SD
Enformer DNASE cross-track SD / source-fit SD
source-scale standardized absolute Enformer/Borzoi DNASE disagreement
candidate-block Enformer and Borzoi prediction SDs / source-fit SDs
six signed ATAC/CAGE/H3K27ac means and six missingness flags

fixed_estimator.family_weighting: Each fit/calibration family total weight equal
fixed_estimator.calibration: Source calibration-family isotonic; raw risk used for ranking

source_split: SHA256(seed + family string), ascending digest; first ceil(0.25 * 19)=5 families calibrate, remaining14 fit
candidate_context_spread: Inference-only SD within fixed dataset/1Mb candidate block, computed without labels. Candidate-set-dependent, not a reliability claim for an isolated variant. Same transform is frozen for fit/calibration/external sets.
optional_AlphaGenome_policy: Only with applicable permission: augment with source-fit-standardized AlphaGenome DNASE mean; use maximum signed pairwise standardized disagreement among the three models. Same source split/hyperparameters and external rule, secondary only.
